notes.title: A first update of many
notes.content:
We're incredibly excited to have The Chronicles of Rovania: Darkest Bridge listed on Steam. Even though you're only able to wishlist our title, we welcome you to spread the word far and wide. The bigger following we can get while starting out the better! 

It's going to be a wild but epic development journey and we'd like you to join us every step of the way. We also to encourage you to engage with us and let us know what you are thinking! Thank you for the interest and stay tuned, there's some amazing work in the pipeline and we can't wait to share it with you!
